<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {

    const carousels = document.querySelectorAll(
        ".noun-testimonial-carousel"
    );


    carousels.forEach(function (carousel) {

        if (carousel.dataset.carouselReady === "true") {
            return;
        }

        carousel.dataset.carouselReady = "true";


        /* =========================================
           GET ORIGINAL DIVI COLUMNS
           ========================================= */

        const originalColumns = Array.from(
            carousel.children
        ).filter(function (element) {

            return element.classList.contains("et_pb_column");

        });


        if (originalColumns.length < 2) {
            return;
        }


        const originalCount =
            originalColumns.length;


        /* =========================================
           CREATE VIEWPORT
           ========================================= */

        const viewport =
            document.createElement("div");

        viewport.className =
            "noun-carousel-viewport";


        /* =========================================
           CREATE TRACK
           ========================================= */

        const track =
            document.createElement("div");

        track.className =
            "noun-carousel-track";


        /* =========================================
           CREATE CLONES
           ========================================= */

        const beforeClones =
            originalColumns.map(function (column) {

                const clone =
                    column.cloneNode(true);

                clone.classList.add(
                    "noun-carousel-clone"
                );

                return clone;

            });


        const afterClones =
            originalColumns.map(function (column) {

                const clone =
                    column.cloneNode(true);

                clone.classList.add(
                    "noun-carousel-clone"
                );

                return clone;

            });


        /* =========================================
           BUILD TRACK
           ========================================= */

        beforeClones.forEach(function (clone) {

            track.appendChild(clone);

        });


        originalColumns.forEach(function (column) {

            track.appendChild(column);

        });


        afterClones.forEach(function (clone) {

            track.appendChild(clone);

        });


        viewport.appendChild(track);

        carousel.appendChild(viewport);


        /* =========================================
           CONTROLS
           ========================================= */

        const previous =
            document.createElement("button");

        previous.className =
            "noun-carousel-prev";

        previous.type = "button";

        previous.setAttribute(
            "aria-label",
            "Previous testimonial"
        );

        previous.innerHTML = "❮";


        const next =
            document.createElement("button");

        next.className =
            "noun-carousel-next";

        next.type = "button";

        next.setAttribute(
            "aria-label",
            "Next testimonial"
        );

        next.innerHTML = "❯";


        carousel.appendChild(previous);

        carousel.appendChild(next);


        /* =========================================
           DOTS
           ========================================= */

        const dots =
            document.createElement("div");

        dots.className =
            "noun-carousel-dots";

        carousel.appendChild(dots);


        for (
            let i = 0;
            i < originalCount;
            i++
        ) {

            const dot =
                document.createElement("button");

            dot.type = "button";

            dot.className =
                "noun-carousel-dot";

            dot.setAttribute(
                "aria-label",
                "Go to testimonial " + (i + 1)
            );


            dot.addEventListener(
                "click",
                function () {

                    goToSlide(
                        originalCount + i
                    );

                    restartAutoSlide();

                }
            );


            dots.appendChild(dot);

        }


        /* =========================================
           SETTINGS
           ========================================= */

        const GAP = 20;

        let visibleSlides = 3;

        let cardWidth = 0;

        let currentIndex =
            originalCount;

        let isAnimating = false;

        let autoSlide = null;


        /* =========================================
           DETERMINE VISIBLE CARDS
           ========================================= */

        function getVisibleSlides() {

            if (window.innerWidth <= 767) {

                return 1;

            }

            if (window.innerWidth <= 980) {

                return 2;

            }

            return 3;

        }


        /* =========================================
           CALCULATE CARD WIDTH
           ========================================= */

        function calculateDimensions() {

            visibleSlides =
                getVisibleSlides();


            const viewportWidth =
                viewport.getBoundingClientRect().width;


            cardWidth =
                (
                    viewportWidth -
                    (
                        GAP *
                        (visibleSlides - 1)
                    )
                ) /
                visibleSlides;


            /*
             * Pass the calculated width
             * to CSS.
             */

            carousel.style.setProperty(
                "--noun-card-width",
                cardWidth + "px"
            );


            positionTrack(false);

        }


        /* =========================================
           POSITION TRACK
           ========================================= */

        function positionTrack(animate) {

            if (animate) {

                track.style.transition =
                    "transform 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1)";

            } else {

                track.style.transition =
                    "none";

            }


            /*
             * IMPORTANT:
             *
             * Every card has exactly GAP spacing.
             *
             * This means:
             *
             * 1 [20px] 2
             * 2 [20px] 3
             * 3 [20px] 4
             * 4 [20px] 1
             *
             * There can no longer be a
             * glued boundary.
             */

            const movement =
                currentIndex *
                (
                    cardWidth +
                    GAP
                );


            track.style.transform =
                "translate3d(-" +
                movement +
                "px, 0, 0)";


            updateDots();

        }


        /* =========================================
           UPDATE DOTS
           ========================================= */

        function updateDots() {

            const dotButtons =
                dots.querySelectorAll(
                    ".noun-carousel-dot"
                );


            let realIndex =
                (
                    currentIndex -
                    originalCount
                ) %
                originalCount;


            if (realIndex < 0) {

                realIndex +=
                    originalCount;

            }


            dotButtons.forEach(
                function (dot, index) {

                    dot.classList.toggle(
                        "active",
                        index === realIndex
                    );

                }
            );

        }


        /* =========================================
           NEXT
           ========================================= */

        function nextSlide() {

            if (isAnimating) {
                return;
            }


            isAnimating = true;

            currentIndex++;

            positionTrack(true);

        }


        /* =========================================
           PREVIOUS
           ========================================= */

        function previousSlide() {

            if (isAnimating) {
                return;
            }


            isAnimating = true;

            currentIndex--;

            positionTrack(true);

        }


        /* =========================================
           GO TO SPECIFIC SLIDE
           ========================================= */

        function goToSlide(index) {

            if (isAnimating) {
                return;
            }


            isAnimating = true;

            currentIndex = index;

            positionTrack(true);

        }


        /* =========================================
           INFINITE LOOP RESET
           ========================================= */

        track.addEventListener(
            "transitionend",
            function (event) {

                if (
                    event.propertyName !==
                    "transform"
                ) {

                    return;

                }


                /*
                 * We have moved into the
                 * second clone group.
                 */

                if (
                    currentIndex >=
                    originalCount * 2
                ) {

                    currentIndex -=
                        originalCount;


                    positionTrack(false);

                }


                /*
                 * We have moved into the
                 * first clone group.
                 */

                else if (
                    currentIndex <
                    originalCount
                ) {

                    currentIndex +=
                        originalCount;


                    positionTrack(false);

                }


                isAnimating = false;

            }
        );


        /* =========================================
           BUTTONS
           ========================================= */

        next.addEventListener(
            "click",
            function () {

                nextSlide();

                restartAutoSlide();

            }
        );


        previous.addEventListener(
            "click",
            function () {

                previousSlide();

                restartAutoSlide();

            }
        );


        /* =========================================
           AUTO PLAY
           ========================================= */

        function startAutoSlide() {

            clearInterval(autoSlide);


            autoSlide =
                setInterval(
                    function () {

                        nextSlide();

                    },
                    5000
                );

        }


        function restartAutoSlide() {

            clearInterval(autoSlide);

            startAutoSlide();

        }


        /* =========================================
           PAUSE ON HOVER
           ========================================= */

        carousel.addEventListener(
            "mouseenter",
            function () {

                clearInterval(autoSlide);

            }
        );


        carousel.addEventListener(
            "mouseleave",
            function () {

                startAutoSlide();

            }
        );


        /* =========================================
           TOUCH SWIPE
           ========================================= */

        let touchStartX = 0;

        let touchEndX = 0;


        viewport.addEventListener(
            "touchstart",
            function (event) {

                touchStartX =
                    event.touches[0].clientX;

                clearInterval(autoSlide);

            },
            { passive: true }
        );


        viewport.addEventListener(
            "touchend",
            function (event) {

                touchEndX =
                    event.changedTouches[0].clientX;


                const distance =
                    touchStartX -
                    touchEndX;


                if (
                    Math.abs(distance) >= 50
                ) {

                    if (distance > 0) {

                        nextSlide();

                    } else {

                        previousSlide();

                    }

                }


                restartAutoSlide();

            },
            { passive: true }
        );


        /* =========================================
           RESIZE
           ========================================= */

        let resizeTimer;


        window.addEventListener(
            "resize",
            function () {

                clearTimeout(resizeTimer);


                resizeTimer =
                    setTimeout(
                        function () {

                            calculateDimensions();

                        },
                        150
                    );

            }
        );


        /* =========================================
           INITIALIZE
           ========================================= */

        calculateDimensions();

        updateDots();

        startAutoSlide();

    });

});

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {

    const carousels = document.querySelectorAll(
        ".noun-testimonial-carousel"
    );


    carousels.forEach(function (carousel) {

        if (carousel.dataset.carouselReady === "true") {
            return;
        }

        carousel.dataset.carouselReady = "true";


        /* =========================================
           GET ORIGINAL DIVI COLUMNS
           ========================================= */

        const originalColumns = Array.from(
            carousel.children
        ).filter(function (element) {

            return element.classList.contains("et_pb_column");

        });


        if (originalColumns.length < 2) {
            return;
        }


        const originalCount =
            originalColumns.length;


        /* =========================================
           CREATE VIEWPORT
           ========================================= */

        const viewport =
            document.createElement("div");

        viewport.className =
            "noun-carousel-viewport";


        /* =========================================
           CREATE TRACK
           ========================================= */

        const track =
            document.createElement("div");

        track.className =
            "noun-carousel-track";


        /* =========================================
           CREATE CLONES
           ========================================= */

        const beforeClones =
            originalColumns.map(function (column) {

                const clone =
                    column.cloneNode(true);

                clone.classList.add(
                    "noun-carousel-clone"
                );

                return clone;

            });


        const afterClones =
            originalColumns.map(function (column) {

                const clone =
                    column.cloneNode(true);

                clone.classList.add(
                    "noun-carousel-clone"
                );

                return clone;

            });


        /* =========================================
           BUILD TRACK
           ========================================= */

        beforeClones.forEach(function (clone) {

            track.appendChild(clone);

        });


        originalColumns.forEach(function (column) {

            track.appendChild(column);

        });


        afterClones.forEach(function (clone) {

            track.appendChild(clone);

        });


        viewport.appendChild(track);

        carousel.appendChild(viewport);


        /* =========================================
           CONTROLS
           ========================================= */

        const previous =
            document.createElement("button");

        previous.className =
            "noun-carousel-prev";

        previous.type = "button";

        previous.setAttribute(
            "aria-label",
            "Previous testimonial"
        );

        previous.innerHTML = "❮";


        const next =
            document.createElement("button");

        next.className =
            "noun-carousel-next";

        next.type = "button";

        next.setAttribute(
            "aria-label",
            "Next testimonial"
        );

        next.innerHTML = "❯";


        carousel.appendChild(previous);

        carousel.appendChild(next);


        /* =========================================
           DOTS
           ========================================= */

        const dots =
            document.createElement("div");

        dots.className =
            "noun-carousel-dots";

        carousel.appendChild(dots);


        for (
            let i = 0;
            i < originalCount;
            i++
        ) {

            const dot =
                document.createElement("button");

            dot.type = "button";

            dot.className =
                "noun-carousel-dot";

            dot.setAttribute(
                "aria-label",
                "Go to testimonial " + (i + 1)
            );


            dot.addEventListener(

            "click",
            function () {

                nextSlide();

                restartAutoSlide();

            }
        );


        previous.addEventListener(
            "click",
            function () {

                previousSlide();

                restartAutoSlide();

            }
        );

           AUTO PLAY
           ========================================= */

        function startAutoSlide() {

            autoSlide =
                setInterval(
                    function () {

                        nextSlide();

                    },
                    5000
                );

            clearInterval(autoSlide);

            startAutoSlide();

        }

        carousel.addEventListener(
            "mouseenter",
            function () {

                clearInterval(autoSlide);

        );

            "mouseleave",
            function () {

            }
        );

        let touchEndX = 0;

                    } else {

                        previousSlide();

                    }

                }


                restartAutoSlide();

            },
            { passive: true }
        );

           RESIZE
           ========================================= */

        let resizeTimer;


        window.addEventListener(
            "resize",
            function () {

                clearTimeout(resizeTimer);


                resizeTimer =
                    setTimeout(
                        function () {

                            calculateDimensions();

                        },
                        150
                    );

            }
        );

           INITIALIZE
           ========================================= */

        calculateDimensions();

        updateDots();

        startAutoSlide();

				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><h2>Welcome Message from the Vice-Chancellor</h2></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_2  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				
				
				
				
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p style="text-align: justify;">Welcome to the National Open University of Nigeria – Nigeria’s foremost Open and Distance Learning institution and a beacon of accessible, inclusive and technology-driven education in Africa.</p>
<p style="text-align: justify;">At NOUN, we believe that education is not a privilege for the few, but a right for all. Our mandate is clear: to remove barriers, expand opportunity, and deliver quality university education to every Nigerian, regardless of age, geography, profession, or circumstance.</p>
<p style="text-align: justify;">We combine flexibility with academic rigour, innovation with integrity, and access with excellence. With over 190,000 students spread across 128 study centres and robust digital platforms, we empower learners to pursue their academic goals without putting their lives on hold.</p>
<p style="text-align: justify;">To our students: you are at the heart of everything we do. Your determination inspires us, and we are committed to ensuring that your degrees remain credible, competitive, and globally respected.</p>
<p style="text-align: justify;">To our staff and partners: together, we will continue to strengthen governance, enhance quality, and position NOUN as a globally competitive, research-informed, and future-ready university.</p>
<p style="text-align: justify;">The future of higher education is flexible, inclusive, and technology-enabled – and NOUN is proud to lead that future.</p>
<p style="text-align: justify;">Welcome to a University without walls.<br />Welcome to NOUN.</p></div>

I remain grateful to NOUN for this and many more achievements.</p><p> </p></div><div class="wpmtst-testimonial-image testimonial-image"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="150" height="150" src="https://nou.edu.ng/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/timoty-1-150x150.png" class="attachment-thumbnail size-thumbnail wp-post-image" alt="" srcset="https://nou.edu.ng/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/timoty-1-150x150.png 150w, https://nou.edu.ng/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/timoty-1-75x75.png 75w" sizes="(max-width: 150px) 100vw, 150px" /></div><div class="wpmtst-testimonial-field testimonial-field testimonial-name">Timothy Manasseh Garkuwa</div><div class="wpmtst-testimonial-field testimonial-field testimonial-company">Student - North-East II, Bogoro, Incubatee</div><div class="clear"></div></div></div><div class="wpmtst-testimonial testimonial t-slide post-9501"><div class="wpmtst-testimonial-inner testimonial-inner"><div data-infinite-loop="true"  class="wpmtst-testimonial-content  testimonial-content"><p>There is a proverb that says, “it takes a village to raise a child”. <script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {

    const carousels = document.querySelectorAll(
        ".noun-testimonial-carousel"
    );


    carousels.forEach(function (carousel) {

        if (carousel.dataset.carouselReady === "true") {
            return;
        }

        carousel.dataset.carouselReady = "true";


        /* =========================================
           GET ORIGINAL DIVI COLUMNS
           ========================================= */

        const originalColumns = Array.from(
            carousel.children
        ).filter(function (element) {

            return element.classList.contains("et_pb_column");

        });


        if (originalColumns.length < 2) {
            return;
        }


        const originalCount =
            originalColumns.length;


        /* =========================================
           CREATE VIEWPORT
           ========================================= */

        const viewport =
            document.createElement("div");

        viewport.className =
            "noun-carousel-viewport";


        /* =========================================
           CREATE TRACK
           ========================================= */

        const track =
            document.createElement("div");

        track.className =
            "noun-carousel-track";


        /* =========================================
           CREATE CLONES
           ========================================= */

        const beforeClones =
            originalColumns.map(function (column) {

                const clone =
                    column.cloneNode(true);

                clone.classList.add(
                    "noun-carousel-clone"
                );

                return clone;

            });


        const afterClones =
            originalColumns.map(function (column) {

                const clone =
                    column.cloneNode(true);

                clone.classList.add(
                    "noun-carousel-clone"
                );

                return clone;

            });


        /* =========================================
           BUILD TRACK
           ========================================= */

        beforeClones.forEach(function (clone) {

            track.appendChild(clone);

        });


        originalColumns.forEach(function (column) {

            track.appendChild(column);

        });


        afterClones.forEach(function (clone) {

            track.appendChild(clone);

        });


        viewport.appendChild(track);

        carousel.appendChild(viewport);


        /* =========================================
           CONTROLS
           ========================================= */

        const previous =
            document.createElement("button");

        previous.className =
            "noun-carousel-prev";

        previous.type = "button";

        previous.setAttribute(
            "aria-label",
            "Previous testimonial"
        );

        previous.innerHTML = "❮";


        const next =
            document.createElement("button");

        next.className =
            "noun-carousel-next";

        next.type = "button";

        next.setAttribute(
            "aria-label",
            "Next testimonial"
        );

        next.innerHTML = "❯";


        carousel.appendChild(previous);

        carousel.appendChild(next);


        /* =========================================
           DOTS
           ========================================= */

        const dots =
            document.createElement("div");

        dots.className =
            "noun-carousel-dots";

        carousel.appendChild(dots);


        for (
            let i = 0;
            i < originalCount;
            i++
        ) {

            const dot =
                document.createElement("button");

            dot.type = "button";

            dot.className =
                "noun-carousel-dot";

            dot.setAttribute(
                "aria-label",
                "Go to testimonial " + (i + 1)
            );


            dot.addEventListener(
                "click",
                function () {

                    goToSlide(
                        originalCount + i
                    );

                    restartAutoSlide();

                }
            );


            dots.appendChild(dot);

        }


        /* =========================================
           SETTINGS
           ========================================= */

        const GAP = 20;

        let visibleSlides = 3;

        let cardWidth = 0;

        let currentIndex =
            originalCount;

        let isAnimating = false;

        let autoSlide = null;


        /* =========================================

           ========================================= */

        function getVisibleSlides() {

            if (window.innerWidth <= 767) {

                return 1;

            }

            if (window.innerWidth <= 980) {

                return 2;

            }

            return 3;

        }


        /* =========================================
           CALCULATE CARD WIDTH
           ========================================= */

        function calculateDimensions() {

            visibleSlides =
                getVisibleSlides();


            const viewportWidth =
                viewport.getBoundingClientRect().width;


            cardWidth =
                (
                    viewportWidth -
                    (
                        GAP *
                        (visibleSlides - 1)
                    )
                ) /
                visibleSlides;


            /*
             * Pass the calculated width
             * to CSS.
             */

            carousel.style.setProperty(
                "--noun-card-width",
                cardWidth + "px"
            );


            positionTrack(false);

        }


        /* =========================================
           POSITION TRACK
           ========================================= */

        function positionTrack(animate) {

            if (animate) {

                track.style.transition =
                    "transform 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1)";

            } else {

                track.style.transition =
                    "none";

            }


            /*
             * IMPORTANT:
             *
             * Every card has exactly GAP spacing.
             *
             * This means:
             *
             * 1 [20px] 2
             * 2 [20px] 3
             * 3 [20px] 4
             * 4 [20px] 1
             *
             * There can no longer be a
             * glued boundary.
             */

            const movement =
                currentIndex *
                (
                    cardWidth +
                    GAP
                );


            track.style.transform =
                "translate3d(-" +
                movement +
                "px, 0, 0)";


            updateDots();

        }


        /* =========================================
           UPDATE DOTS
           ========================================= */

        function updateDots() {

            const dotButtons =
                dots.querySelectorAll(
                    ".noun-carousel-dot"
                );


            let realIndex =
                (
                    currentIndex -
                    originalCount
                ) %
                originalCount;


            if (realIndex < 0) {

                realIndex +=
                    originalCount;

            }


            dotButtons.forEach(
                function (dot, index) {

                    dot.classList.toggle(
                        "active",
                        index === realIndex
                    );

                }
            );

        }


        /* =========================================
           NEXT
           ========================================= */

        function nextSlide() {

            if (isAnimating) {
                return;
            }


            isAnimating = true;

            currentIndex++;

            positionTrack(true);

        }


        /* =========================================
           PREVIOUS
           ========================================= */

        function previousSlide() {

            if (isAnimating) {
                return;
            }


            isAnimating = true;

            currentIndex--;

            positionTrack(true);

        }


        /* =========================================
           GO TO SPECIFIC SLIDE
           ========================================= */

        function goToSlide(index) {

            if (isAnimating) {
                return;
            }


            isAnimating = true;

            currentIndex = index;

            positionTrack(true);

        }


        /* =========================================
           INFINITE LOOP RESET
           ========================================= */

        track.addEventListener(
            "transitionend",
            function (event) {

                if (
                    event.propertyName !==
                    "transform"

                }

                 * We have moved into the
                 * second clone group.
                 */

                    currentIndex >=
                    originalCount * 2
                ) {

                    currentIndex -=
                        originalCount;


                    positionTrack(false);

                }


                /*
                 * We have moved into the
                 * first clone group.
                 */

                else if (
                    currentIndex <
                    originalCount
                ) {

                    currentIndex +=
                        originalCount;


                    positionTrack(false);

                }


                isAnimating = false;

            }
        );


        /* =========================================
           BUTTONS
           ========================================= */

        next.addEventListener(
            "click",
            function () {

                nextSlide();

                restartAutoSlide();

            }
        );


        previous.addEventListener(
            "click",
            function () {

                previousSlide();

                restartAutoSlide();

            }
        );


        /* =========================================
           AUTO PLAY
           ========================================= */

        function startAutoSlide() {

            clearInterval(autoSlide);


            autoSlide =
                setInterval(
                    function () {

                        nextSlide();

                    },
                    5000
                );

        }


        function restartAutoSlide() {

            clearInterval(autoSlide);

            startAutoSlide();

        }


        /* =========================================
           PAUSE ON HOVER
           ========================================= */

        carousel.addEventListener(
            "mouseenter",
            function () {

                clearInterval(autoSlide);

            }
        );


        carousel.addEventListener(
            "mouseleave",
            function () {

                startAutoSlide();

            }
        );


        /* =========================================
           TOUCH SWIPE
           ========================================= */

        let touchStartX = 0;

        let touchEndX = 0;


        viewport.addEventListener(
            "touchstart",
            function (event) {

                touchStartX =
                    event.touches[0].clientX;

                clearInterval(autoSlide);

            },
            { passive: true }
        );


        viewport.addEventListener(
            "touchend",
            function (event) {

                touchEndX =
                    event.changedTouches[0].clientX;


                const distance =
                    touchStartX -
                    touchEndX;


                if (
                    Math.abs(distance) >= 50
                ) {

                    if (distance > 0) {

                        nextSlide();

                    } else {

                        previousSlide();

                    }

                }


                restartAutoSlide();

            },
            { passive: true }
        );


        /* =========================================
           RESIZE
           ========================================= */

        let resizeTimer;


        window.addEventListener(
            "resize",
            function () {

                clearTimeout(resizeTimer);


                resizeTimer =
                    setTimeout(
                        function () {

                            calculateDimensions();

                        },
                        150
                    );

            }
        );


        /* =========================================
           INITIALIZE
           ========================================= */

        calculateDimensions();

        updateDots();

        startAutoSlide();

    });

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {

    const carousels = document.querySelectorAll(
        ".noun-testimonial-carousel"
    );


    carousels.forEach(function (carousel) {

        if (carousel.dataset.carouselReady === "true") {
            return;
        }

        carousel.dataset.carouselReady = "true";


        /* =========================================
           GET ORIGINAL DIVI COLUMNS
           ========================================= */

        const originalColumns = Array.from(
            carousel.children
        ).filter(function (element) {

            return element.classList.contains("et_pb_column");

        });


        if (originalColumns.length < 2) {
            return;
        }


        const originalCount =
            originalColumns.length;


        /* =========================================
           CREATE VIEWPORT
           ========================================= */

        const viewport =
            document.createElement("div");

        viewport.className =
            "noun-carousel-viewport";


        /* =========================================
           CREATE TRACK
           ========================================= */

        const track =
            document.createElement("div");

        track.className =
            "noun-carousel-track";


        /* =========================================
           CREATE CLONES
           ========================================= */

        const beforeClones =
            originalColumns.map(function (column) {

                const clone =
                    column.cloneNode(true);

                clone.classList.add(
                    "noun-carousel-clone"
                );

                return clone;

            });


        const afterClones =
            originalColumns.map(function (column) {

                const clone =
                    column.cloneNode(true);

                clone.classList.add(
                    "noun-carousel-clone"
                );

                return clone;

            });


        /* =========================================
           BUILD TRACK
           ========================================= */

        beforeClones.forEach(function (clone) {

            track.appendChild(clone);

        });


        originalColumns.forEach(function (column) {

            track.appendChild(column);

        });


        afterClones.forEach(function (clone) {

            track.appendChild(clone);

        });


        viewport.appendChild(track);

        carousel.appendChild(viewport);


        /* =========================================
           CONTROLS
           ========================================= */

        const previous =
            document.createElement("button");

        previous.className =
            "noun-carousel-prev";

        previous.type = "button";

        previous.setAttribute(
            "aria-label",
            "Previous testimonial"
        );

        previous.innerHTML = "❮";


        const next =
            document.createElement("button");

        next.className =
            "noun-carousel-next";

        next.type = "button";

        next.setAttribute(
            "aria-label",
            "Next testimonial"
        );

        next.innerHTML = "❯";


        carousel.appendChild(previous);

        carousel.appendChild(next);


        /* =========================================
           DOTS
           ========================================= */

        const dots =
            document.createElement("div");

        dots.className =
            "noun-carousel-dots";

        carousel.appendChild(dots);


        for (
            let i = 0;
            i < originalCount;
            i++
        ) {

            const dot =
                document.createElement("button");

            dot.type = "button";

            dot.className =
                "noun-carousel-dot";

            dot.setAttribute(
                "aria-label",
                "Go to testimonial " + (i + 1)
            );


            dot.addEventListener(
                "click",
                function () {

                    goToSlide(
                        originalCount + i
                    );

                    restartAutoSlide();

                }
            );


            dots.appendChild(dot);

        }


        /* =========================================
           SETTINGS
           ========================================= */

        const GAP = 20;

        let visibleSlides = 3;

        let cardWidth = 0;

        let currentIndex =
            originalCount;

        let isAnimating = false;

        let autoSlide = null;


        /* =========================================
           DETERMINE VISIBLE CARDS
           ========================================= */

        function getVisibleSlides() {

            if (window.innerWidth <= 767) {

                return 1;

            }

            if (window.innerWidth <= 980) {

                return 2;

            }

            return 3;

        }


        /* =========================================
           CALCULATE CARD WIDTH
           ========================================= */

        function calculateDimensions() {

            visibleSlides =
                getVisibleSlides();


            const viewportWidth =
                viewport.getBoundingClientRect().width;


            cardWidth =
                (
                    viewportWidth -
                    (
                        GAP *
                        (visibleSlides - 1)
                    )
                ) /
                visibleSlides;


            /*
             * Pass the calculated width
             * to CSS.
             */

            carousel.style.setProperty(
                "--noun-card-width",
                cardWidth + "px"
            );


            positionTrack(false);

        }


        /* =========================================
           POSITION TRACK
           ========================================= */

        function positionTrack(animate) {

            if (animate) {

                track.style.transition =
                    "transform 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1)";

            } else {

                track.style.transition =
                    "none";

            }


            /*
             * IMPORTANT:
             *
             * Every card has exactly GAP spacing.
             *
             * This means:
             *
             * 1 [20px] 2
             * 2 [20px] 3
             * 3 [20px] 4
             * 4 [20px] 1
             *
             * There can no longer be a
             * glued boundary.
             */

            const movement =
                currentIndex *
                (
                    cardWidth +
                    GAP
                );


            track.style.transform =
                "translate3d(-" +
                movement +
                "px, 0, 0)";


            updateDots();

        }


        /* =========================================
           UPDATE DOTS
           ========================================= */

        function updateDots() {

            const dotButtons =
                dots.querySelectorAll(
                    ".noun-carousel-dot"
                );


            let realIndex =
                (
                    currentIndex -
                    originalCount
                ) %
                originalCount;


            if (realIndex < 0) {

                realIndex +=
                    originalCount;

            }


            dotButtons.forEach(
                function (dot, index) {

                    dot.classList.toggle(
                        "active",
                        index === realIndex
                    );

                }
            );

        }


        /* =========================================
           NEXT
           ========================================= */

        function nextSlide() {

            if (isAnimating) {
                return;
            }


            isAnimating = true;

            currentIndex++;

            positionTrack(true);

        }


        /* =========================================
           PREVIOUS
           ========================================= */

        function previousSlide() {

            if (isAnimating) {
                return;
            }


            isAnimating = true;

            currentIndex--;

            positionTrack(true);

        }


        /* =========================================
           GO TO SPECIFIC SLIDE
           ========================================= */

        function goToSlide(index) {

            if (isAnimating) {
                return;
            }


            isAnimating = true;

            currentIndex = index;

            positionTrack(true);

        }


        /* =========================================
           INFINITE LOOP RESET
           ========================================= */

        track.addEventListener(
            "transitionend",
            function (event) {

                if (
                    event.propertyName !==
                    "transform"
                ) {

                    return;

                }


                /*
                 * We have moved into the
                 * second clone group.
                 */

                if (
                    currentIndex >=
                    originalCount * 2
                ) {

                    currentIndex -=
                        originalCount;


                    positionTrack(false);

                }


                /*
                 * We have moved into the
                 * first clone group.
                 */

                else if (
                    currentIndex <
                    originalCount

                    currentIndex +=
                        originalCount;


                    positionTrack(false);

                }


                isAnimating = false;

            }
        );

           ========================================= */

        next.addEventListener(
            "click",
            function () {

                nextSlide();

                restartAutoSlide();

            }
        );


        previous.addEventListener(
            "click",
            function () {

                previousSlide();

                restartAutoSlide();

            }
        );


        /* =========================================
           AUTO PLAY
           ========================================= */

        function startAutoSlide() {

            clearInterval(autoSlide);


            autoSlide =
                setInterval(
                    function () {

                        nextSlide();

                    },
                    5000
                );

        }


        function restartAutoSlide() {

            clearInterval(autoSlide);

            startAutoSlide();

        }


        /* =========================================

           ========================================= */

        carousel.addEventListener(
            "mouseenter",
            function () {

                clearInterval(autoSlide);

            }
        );


        carousel.addEventListener(
            "mouseleave",
            function () {

                startAutoSlide();

            }
        );

           ========================================= */

        let touchStartX = 0;

        let touchEndX = 0;


        viewport.addEventListener(
            "touchstart",
            function (event) {

                touchStartX =
                    event.touches[0].clientX;

                clearInterval(autoSlide);

            },
            { passive: true }

            "touchend",
            function (event) {

                touchEndX =
                    event.changedTouches[0].clientX;


                const distance =
                    touchStartX -
                    touchEndX;


                if (
                    Math.abs(distance) >= 50
                ) {

                    if (distance > 0) {

                        nextSlide();

                    } else {

                        previousSlide();

                    }

                }


                restartAutoSlide();

            },
            { passive: true }
        );

           RESIZE
           ========================================= */

        let resizeTimer;


        window.addEventListener(
            "resize",
            function () {

                clearTimeout(resizeTimer);


                resizeTimer =
                    setTimeout(
                        function () {

                            calculateDimensions();

                        },
                        150
                    );

            }
        );

           INITIALIZE

        calculateDimensions();

        updateDots();

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {

    const carousels = document.querySelectorAll(
        ".noun-testimonial-carousel"
    );


    carousels.forEach(function (carousel) {

        if (carousel.dataset.carouselReady === "true") {
            return;
        }

        carousel.dataset.carouselReady = "true";


        /* =========================================
           GET ORIGINAL DIVI COLUMNS
           ========================================= */

        const originalColumns = Array.from(
            carousel.children
        ).filter(function (element) {

            return element.classList.contains("et_pb_column");

        });


        if (originalColumns.length < 2) {
            return;
        }


        const originalCount =
            originalColumns.length;


        /* =========================================
           CREATE VIEWPORT
           ========================================= */

        const viewport =
            document.createElement("div");

        viewport.className =
            "noun-carousel-viewport";


        /* =========================================
           CREATE TRACK
           ========================================= */

        const track =
            document.createElement("div");

        track.className =
            "noun-carousel-track";


        /* =========================================
           CREATE CLONES
           ========================================= */

        const beforeClones =
            originalColumns.map(function (column) {

                const clone =
                    column.cloneNode(true);

                clone.classList.add(
                    "noun-carousel-clone"
                );

                return clone;

            });


        const afterClones =
            originalColumns.map(function (column) {

                const clone =
                    column.cloneNode(true);

                clone.classList.add(
                    "noun-carousel-clone"
                );

                return clone;

            });


        /* =========================================
           BUILD TRACK
           ========================================= */

        beforeClones.forEach(function (clone) {

            track.appendChild(clone);

        });


        originalColumns.forEach(function (column) {

            track.appendChild(column);

        });


        afterClones.forEach(function (clone) {

            track.appendChild(clone);

        });


        viewport.appendChild(track);

        carousel.appendChild(viewport);


        /* =========================================
           CONTROLS
           ========================================= */

        const previous =
            document.createElement("button");

        previous.className =
            "noun-carousel-prev";

        previous.type = "button";

        previous.setAttribute(
            "aria-label",
            "Previous testimonial"
        );

        previous.innerHTML = "❮";


        const next =
            document.createElement("button");

        next.className =
            "noun-carousel-next";

        next.type = "button";

        next.setAttribute(
            "aria-label",
            "Next testimonial"
        );

        next.innerHTML = "❯";


        carousel.appendChild(previous);

        carousel.appendChild(next);


        /* =========================================
           DOTS
           ========================================= */

        const dots =
            document.createElement("div");

        dots.className =
            "noun-carousel-dots";

        carousel.appendChild(dots);


        for (
            let i = 0;
            i < originalCount;
            i++
        ) {

            const dot =
                document.createElement("button");

            dot.type = "button";

            dot.className =
                "noun-carousel-dot";

            dot.setAttribute(
                "aria-label",
                "Go to testimonial " + (i + 1)
            );


            dot.addEventListener(
                "click",
                function () {

                    goToSlide(
                        originalCount + i
                    );

                    restartAutoSlide();

                }
            );


            dots.appendChild(dot);

        }


        /* =========================================
           SETTINGS
           ========================================= */

        const GAP = 20;

        let visibleSlides = 3;

        let cardWidth = 0;

        let currentIndex =
            originalCount;

        let isAnimating = false;

        let autoSlide = null;


        /* =========================================
           DETERMINE VISIBLE CARDS
           ========================================= */

        function getVisibleSlides() {

            if (window.innerWidth <= 767) {

                return 1;

            }

            if (window.innerWidth <= 980) {

                return 2;

            }

            return 3;

        }


        /* =========================================
           CALCULATE CARD WIDTH
           ========================================= */

        function calculateDimensions() {

            visibleSlides =
                getVisibleSlides();


            const viewportWidth =
                viewport.getBoundingClientRect().width;


            cardWidth =
                (
                    viewportWidth -
                    (
                        GAP *
                        (visibleSlides - 1)
                    )
                ) /
                visibleSlides;


            /*
             * Pass the calculated width
             * to CSS.
             */

            carousel.style.setProperty(
                "--noun-card-width",
                cardWidth + "px"
            );


            positionTrack(false);

        }


        /* =========================================
           POSITION TRACK
           ========================================= */

        function positionTrack(animate) {

            if (animate) {

                track.style.transition =
                    "transform 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1)";

            } else {

                track.style.transition =
                    "none";

            }


            /*
             * IMPORTANT:
             *
             * Every card has exactly GAP spacing.
             *
             * This means:
             *
             * 1 [20px] 2
             * 2 [20px] 3
             * 3 [20px] 4
             * 4 [20px] 1
             *
             * There can no longer be a
             * glued boundary.
             */

            const movement =
                currentIndex *
                (
                    cardWidth +
                    GAP
                );


            track.style.transform =
                "translate3d(-" +
                movement +
                "px, 0, 0)";


            updateDots();

        }


        /* =========================================
           UPDATE DOTS
           ========================================= */

        function updateDots() {

            const dotButtons =
                dots.querySelectorAll(
                    ".noun-carousel-dot"
                );


            let realIndex =
                (
                    currentIndex -
                    originalCount
                ) %
                originalCount;


            if (realIndex < 0) {

                realIndex +=
                    originalCount;

            }


            dotButtons.forEach(
                function (dot, index) {

                    dot.classList.toggle(
                        "active",
                        index === realIndex
                    );

                }
            );

        }


        /* =========================================
           NEXT
           ========================================= */

        function nextSlide() {

            if (isAnimating) {
                return;
            }


            isAnimating = true;

            currentIndex++;

            positionTrack(true);

        }


        /* =========================================
           PREVIOUS
           ========================================= */

        function previousSlide() {

            if (isAnimating) {
                return;
            }


            isAnimating = true;

            currentIndex--;

            positionTrack(true);

        }


        /* =========================================
           GO TO SPECIFIC SLIDE
           ========================================= */

        function goToSlide(index) {

            if (isAnimating) {
                return;
            }


            isAnimating = true;

            currentIndex = index;

            positionTrack(true);

        }


        /* =========================================
           INFINITE LOOP RESET
           ========================================= */

        track.addEventListener(
            "transitionend",
            function (event) {

                if (
                    event.propertyName !==
                    "transform"
                ) {

                    return;

                }


                /*
                 * We have moved into the
                 * second clone group.
                 */

                if (
                    currentIndex >=
                    originalCount * 2
                ) {

                    currentIndex -=
                        originalCount;


                    positionTrack(false);

                }


                /*
                 * We have moved into the
                 * first clone group.
                 */

                else if (
                    currentIndex <
                    originalCount
                ) {

                    currentIndex +=
                        originalCount;


                    positionTrack(false);

                }


                isAnimating = false;

            }
        );


        /* =========================================
           BUTTONS
           ========================================= */

        next.addEventListener(
            "click",
            function () {

                nextSlide();

                restartAutoSlide();

            }
        );


        previous.addEventListener(
            "click",
            function () {

                previousSlide();

                restartAutoSlide();

            }
        );


        /* =========================================
           AUTO PLAY
           ========================================= */

        function startAutoSlide() {

            clearInterval(autoSlide);


            autoSlide =
                setInterval(
                    function () {

                        nextSlide();

                    },
                    5000
                );

        }


        function restartAutoSlide() {

            clearInterval(autoSlide);

            startAutoSlide();

        }


        /* =========================================
           PAUSE ON HOVER
           ========================================= */

        carousel.addEventListener(
            "mouseenter",
            function () {

                clearInterval(autoSlide);

            }
        );


        carousel.addEventListener(
            "mouseleave",
            function () {

                startAutoSlide();

            }
        );


        /* =========================================
           TOUCH SWIPE
           ========================================= */

        let touchStartX = 0;

        let touchEndX = 0;


        viewport.addEventListener(
            "touchstart",
            function (event) {

                touchStartX =
                    event.touches[0].clientX;

                clearInterval(autoSlide);

            },
            { passive: true }
        );


        viewport.addEventListener(
            "touchend",
            function (event) {

                touchEndX =
                    event.changedTouches[0].clientX;


                const distance =
                    touchStartX -
                    touchEndX;


                if (
                    Math.abs(distance) >= 50
                ) {

                    if (distance > 0) {

                        nextSlide();

                    } else {

                        previousSlide();

                    }

                }


                restartAutoSlide();

            },
            { passive: true }
        );


        /* =========================================
           RESIZE
           ========================================= */

        let resizeTimer;


        window.addEventListener(
            "resize",
            function () {

                clearTimeout(resizeTimer);


                resizeTimer =
                    setTimeout(
                        function () {

                            calculateDimensions();

                        },
                        150
                    );

            }
        );


        /* =========================================
           INITIALIZE
           ========================================= */

        calculateDimensions();

        updateDots();

        startAutoSlide();

    });

});
